page_title: MET 0-0 HAV | Metz v Le Havre 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Hakim Ben El Hadj is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
90+1' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' The Le Havre players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
88' Luka Elsner has decided to make a change. Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) replaces Mohamed Bayo.
82' Joel Asoro will be replaced by Fali Cande (Metz).
81' The referee allows time for a substitution. Benjamin Tetteh will be replaced by Simon Elisor (Metz).
78' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nabil Alioui as he is replaced by Issa Soumare (Le Havre).
78' Luka Elsner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) replacing Daler Kuzyaev.
74' Metz are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
70' Lamine Camara goes off the pitch and Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) comes on.
68' Today's referee Hakim Ben El Hadj rightly decides to book Matthieu Udol (Metz) for his harsh tackle.
66' Lamine Camara (Metz) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
65' The game is interrupted now, Lamine Camara (Metz) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
65' It will be a substitution. Ablie Jallow (Metz) is ready to enter the pitch as Cheikh Sabaly walks off.
61' The resulting corner from Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) comes to nothing.
61' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

59' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) thinks he has scored after reacting fastest to a lofted ball into the box, but Alexandre Oukidja pulls a rabbit out of the hat and makes a stunning save to thwart him for close range.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Emmanuel Sabbi departs the field of play to be replaced by Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
56' Hakim Ben El Hadj shows a yellow card to Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

51' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it whistles wide of the left post so the goalkeeper can relax. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
49' A dangerous looking corner kick from Joel Asoro (Metz) is cleared to safety by the defence.
49' The resulting corner from Joel Asoro (Metz) is cleared by the defence. Metz have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Hakim Ben El Hadj has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
45+1' Joseph Nduquidi (Metz) sees a yellow card from Hakim Ben El Hadj after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Lamine Camara (Metz) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

44' Lamine Camara (Metz) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top left corner only for Arthur Desmas to dive and make a save. The ball goes out of play. Metz are awarded a corner kick.
42' Hakim Ben El Hadj shows a yellow card to Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) for a tough tackle.
40' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
38' Benjamin Tetteh (Metz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' Joel Asoro (Metz) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
35' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Metz force their opponents to concede a corner.

31' What a huge chance for Benjamin Tetteh (Metz). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.

27' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Arthur Desmas shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

27' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the left side of the goal, but Arthur Desmas made an astonishing save!
25' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 0:5.
20' The resulting corner, taken by Nabil Alioui (Le Havre), comes to nothing.

20' What a great touch by Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Le Havre have a corner.
18' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
18' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. Le Havre win a corner kick.
17' Joel Asoro (Metz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
15' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

15' A cross into the box finds the head of Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) who steers it goalwards, but Alexandre Oukidja manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Le Havre.
14' Joel Asoro (Metz) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
12' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) tries to find Loic Nego, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
4' Wonderful movement by Le Havre. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Metz will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Hakim Ben El Hadj.
